title: God's Greatest Gift! 🎁 John 3:16 | Bible Story for Kids | Sunday School
desc:
Did you know God loves you SO much that He gave you the greatest gift ever? 🎁 In this Bible story for kids, Miss Rania's class plays the brown shoes game, Zoe and Leo try to wipe away a black dot (sin!), and we learn how Jesus took away our sins on the cross. What a wonderful gift!

📖 Memory verse: "For God so loved the world that He gave His only begotten Son, that whoever believes in Him should not perish, but have everlasting life." (John 3:16)
🎯 Lesson: Jesus is God's greatest gift. He forgives our sins, and we say thank You by loving Him every day.
🙏 Great for Sunday School, Kindergarten and family devotion time.

⏱️ Chapters
0:00 God's Greatest Gift
0:05 A gift from God
0:15 The brown shoes game
0:30 Adam and Eve and God's plan

1:28 Jesus gave His life
1:36 Red water washes the dot
1:46 Confession: we are clean
1:55 Live with God forever
2:08 How we say thank You
2:23 Leo hugs his mom
2:31 Let's pray
